Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Three talking-to-camera scripts, each around 30 to 45 seconds, in your own voice.

Script 1 · “Every event needs you”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If every event still needs you on site, this is for you.”

Body

“Most event pros are brilliant at delivery. That’s how they got here. But being the best person in the room on event day is a different skill from leading the business. One fills your calendar. The other gives you a business that doesn’t need you at every event.”

CTA

“I’m teaching a free live class called From Planner to Leader. Tap Sign up to save your seat. The replay is included.”

Shot: talking to camera, neutral backdrop, same setup as your talking reels.

Script 2 · “Your pricing”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Your pricing should reflect your expertise, not your hours.”

Body

“Real talk: most event pros price like freelancers and deliver like agencies. Clients aren’t paying for the hours. They’re paying for the judgement that makes the event work. In my free class I’ll show you how to price and present a proposal like a leader.”

CTA

“From Planner to Leader is free and live. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “expertise, not hours” in your serif type.

Script 3 · “The defining decade”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“This is the most defining decade the events industry has ever seen.”

Body

“The industry is valued to reach $2.5 trillion by 2035, and a handful of people will lead it there. After 15 years in events, I can tell you the leaders won’t be the ones working the most events. They’ll be the ones who built the business behind them.”

CTA

“Join my free live class, From Planner to Leader. Sixty minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: walking-and-talking, then cut to close-up for the CTA.
